items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Content card with optional media slot, title, meta and actions. With href, the whole card is one link; actions stay outside the link.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. v4: selected (corner check mark + 2 px frame, no size change) and onSelectedChange (title becomes a stretched button[aria-pressed]; with href, selected is display-only). Rejected: a full-card ink wipe on hover.
